basic_info.description: 212 Castro is a spacious top-floor condo in a boutique 2-unit building, offering a rare blend of original charm and modern potential. Built in 1927 in the classic Marina style, this home features distinctive period details, including high ceilings, large windows, and beautiful hardwood floors throughout. The generous floor plan provides ample space for comfortable living, with an inviting flow between rooms. Enjoy peek-a-boo downtown views from the living room. Potential for modern updates in the kitchen and bath, space to add a second bathroom and roof rights for your future downtown view roof deck. This home is perfectly positioned at the intersection of vibrant city life and historic tranquility, surrounded by tree-lined streets and a blend of well-preserved Victorian and Edwardian architecture. It's the ideal mix of old-world charm and modern living, offering easy access to everything San Francisco has to offer.
